topic: Ibn Sina (980-1037 CE) wrote 'The Canon of Medicine', which was used to teach doctors in Europe for hundreds of years.

episode.title: Ibn Sina (980-1037 CE) | The Canon of Medicine

shots.narration: ایک کتاب سینکڑوں سال ڈاکٹروں کو کیسے پڑھاتی رہی؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, warm 3D animated library with brass instruments and blank-spined books; a giant projected book floats above a table, with no visible text.
shots.action: Hamza tilts his head up toward the giant projected book.
shots.mood: Golden light, wide-eyed curiosity, welcoming mystery.

shots.narration: حمزہ سوچنے لگا، پہلے ڈاکٹر پڑھتے کیسے تھے؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cozy library desk with a small notebook showing only simple drawings, no letters or numbers.
shots.action: Hamza scratches his head over his open notebook.

shots.narration: [excited] نوری نے کہا، آؤ ابن سینا سے ملیں!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, warm library opening into a glowing historical projection, with no text or signs.
shots.action: Noori projects a distant rear-view cartoon depiction of Ibn Sina seated at a study desk.

shots.narration: ابن سینا طب کے مشہور عالم تھے۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, projected historical study with brass lamps, rolled manuscripts and closed unmarked books; Ibn Sina remains small and seen from behind.
shots.action: The distant projected scholar opens a large book.
shots.mood: Quiet scholarship, soft golden workshop light.

shots.narration: انہوں نے القانون فی الطب نام کی کتاب لکھی۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, projected study desk with a large leather-bound volume, blank cover and pages without visible writing; the scholar is distant in the background.
shots.action: Noori enlarges the projected leather-bound book.
shots.mood: Proud discovery, rich leather and warm brass textures.

shots.narration: [excited] طب ہمیں بیماری سمجھنے اور علاج کرنے میں مدد دیتی ہے۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, library tabletop holding a wordless projection of an anatomy drawing beside a brass balance and a closed medicine jar.
shots.action: Hamza points to the projected anatomy drawing.

shots.narration: تو ڈاکٹر بھی کتابوں سے سیکھتے تھے!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cozy library desk with the projected medical book beside Hamza's drawing-only notebook; no visible text.
shots.action: Hamza opens his notebook beside the projected book.

shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, wordless miniature projection transitioning from the historical study to a European teaching hall with stone arches and empty wooden desks.
shots.action: The projected book glides into the European teaching hall.
shots.mood: Wonder at knowledge travelling, soft luminous colors.

shots.narration: [surprised] وہاں سینکڑوں سال ڈاکٹر اس سے پڑھتے رہے!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, projected European teaching desk with the same unmarked medical volume, an arched window and changing seasonal scenery; no people or text.
shots.action: Seasons cycle repeatedly beyond the window beside the book.
shots.mood: A gentle sense of passing time and lasting learning.

shots.narration: حمزہ کو اپنے سوال کا جواب مل گیا۔
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, warm library with the floating medical book above the desk and drawing-only notebook below.
shots.action: Hamza nods at the projected book.

shots.narration: علم واقعی سب کے کام آتا ہے!
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, cozy library with the projected book surrounded by small wordless models of different libraries; no labels or lettering.
shots.action: Noori spreads the book's warm projected glow across the miniature libraries.

shots.narration: [excited] روشنی کا راز کس مسلمان سائنس دان نے سمجھایا؟
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, dim library corner with a tiny aperture projecting an inverted image of a colorful outdoor tree onto a blank screen; no text.
shots.action: Hamza leans toward the upside-down tree image.

episode.endHook: Agli baar: roshni ka raaz kis Musalman science dan ne samjhaya?
episode.description: حمزہ اور نوری کے ساتھ ابن سینا کی مشہور کتاب، القانون فی الطب، کے بارے میں جانیے۔ یہ کتاب یورپ میں سینکڑوں سال ڈاکٹروں کو پڑھانے کے لیے استعمال ہوئی۔
